Aktuell suchen wir: 1 Azure & AI Data Architect (all gender) What you will enjoy doing

Shape the future of data and AI at ALPLA.

At ALPLA, we are transforming the way data is managed, integrated, and leveraged across our global organization. As an Azure & AI Data Architect, you will play a key role in designing and evolving our enterprise data platform while helping unlock the full potential of modern AI technologies. Join a highly skilled and collaborative team driving innovation through data, cloud, and AI.

 * Design, develop, and optimize ALPLA's Azure-based Central Data Hub

 * Build and maintain scalable data integration and transformation solutions

 * Develop and manage enterprise-wide data catalog and governance capabilities

 * Implement and maintain secure data access and protection concepts

 * Support and onboard internal and external data providers and consumers

 * Ensure data quality, availability, and performance through monitoring and automation

 * Drive continuous improvement of data ingestion, storage, and provisioning processes

 * Collaborate with global stakeholders to deliver reliable and future-ready data solutions

 * Explore and leverage modern AI technologies, including Microsoft Copilot and Azure AI services

 

What makes you great

 * University degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field

 * Strong experience with Microsoft Azure data services and cloud architectures

 * Solid understanding of data security, governance, and access management

 * Knowledge of AI technologies and large language models (e.g. Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, Claude, Codex) or a strong willingness to continuously learn in this area

 * Experience with IT Service Management processes and ServiceNow is an advantage

 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

 * Excellent communication skills in English and German

 * Self-driven, structured, and comfortable working within global cross-functional teams

What you can expect working with us

 * Modern Microsoft technology stack and innovative AI solutions (Claude, Codex, etc.)

 * International collaboration across a worldwide organization

 * Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development

 * Flexible working models and attractive employee benefits

 * The possibility to actively shape ALPLA's data and AI landscape

Part of your life. Part of tomorrow.

We make life easier, safer and greener, with technology that achieves more, consumes less and is accessible to everyone. Microelectronics from Infineon is the key to a better future. Efficient use of energy, environmentally-friendly mobility and security in a connected world we solve some of the most critical challenges that our society faces while taking a conscientious approach to the use of natural resources. 1 Staff Engineer Technology Development (f/m/div) Your role

Key responsibilities in your new role

 * Design of masks and layouts for silicon power MOSFETs while balancing process sequences, tolerance requirements and electrical performance targets

 * Definition and enhancement of the design environment, including reference libraries, design rules and verification scripts for new products, technology platforms and technology derivatives

 * Key interface between customer and Mask House

 * Development of innovative electrical characterization structures, test programs and methods to monitor device performance and investigate emerging processes and reliability topics

 * Contribution to the design rules manual in close collaboration with Unit Process, Technology Development and Product Development teams

 * Support of the Process Design Kit and Product Layout teams following technology release

 * Provision of physical design expertise for design changes throughout the product lifecycle and for the definition of new derivative products

Your profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

 * A higher technical school (HTL) or university degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics or Computer Science

 * Sound knowledge of semiconductor process technology, semiconductor physics and MOSFET electrical behavior

 * Relevant professional experience in planar CMOS design and/or vertical MOS design

 * Good knowledge of the flow from design to reticle

 * Sound programming skills, an interest in scripting languages such as Python or SKILL, and familiarity with Unix environments

 * Experience in power MOSFET or analog/mixed-signal layout design using EDA tools such as Cadence

 * Familiarity with electrical characterization techniques, including prober stations, is an advantage

 * Fluency in English and German

1 Information Security Expert (m/f/d) What you will enjoy doingEvery day, our people need to understand why security matters - and when IT fails, ALPLA needs to be ready. As Information Security Expert, you make both happen. You own our security awareness and our IT Emergency Organisation (ITEO), assess information security risks across IT and OT, lead streams within our information security programme TRUST and prepare the evidence for our Cyber-assessments. You report to the CISO and work closely with colleagues in business, IT and OT across our regions and plants.At the core: * Take ownership of Security Awareness at ALPLA and drive trainings, phishing simulations and communication campaigns that foster a strong security culture * Lead and continuously improve ALPLA's IT Emergency Organisation (ITEO), including processes, roles, documentation and exercises * Conduct information security risk assessments in IT and support security assessments in OT environments together with subject matter experts * Lead and coordinate workstreams within our global Information Security programme TRUST * Collaborate with stakeholders across Business, IT and OT to advance ALPLA's security maturity * Support compliance with security standards and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001 and NIS2 * Prepare documentation and evidence for audits, cyber security assessments and compliance reviewsYou own your topics end to end, including the budget for Awareness and the ITEO, and keep the CISO informed on status and KPIs. The overall ISMS, external audits and reporting to management stay with the CISO, so you can concentrate on your topics.What makes you greatYou take over security awareness and the ITEO from day one. Risk assessments, audit support and your TRUST streams follow step by step over your first year, with coaching from experienced colleagues in the team.What you bring * At least two years of experience in information security or security-related IT, for example identity and access management, incident response or security operations * A degree in a technical, scientific or business field, or a comparable qualification * Experience with service ownership, incident response or emergency management * A knack for communication: you explain security clearly to very different audiences, in English and German * Good knowledge of information security management systems and frameworks such as NIS2, ISO 27001 and NIST, and an understanding of how security works in both IT and OT * Experience in project or programme work * A structured, independent way of working: together we set priorities, you take ownership and see things throughNice to have * First experience with risk assessments or audits * Experience in an industrial company * Certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, CISM, CISA or CISSPWhat you can expect working with us * Individual development: We support your certifications, for example ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, and further training * Shape and further develop ALPLA's global Security programme and IT Emergency Organisation * International footprint: You work with regions and plants around the world, across business, IT and OT * Room to grow: A clear path towards a senior governance, risk and compliance role DO & CO operates in Austria, Türkiye, Germany, England, Spain, Italy, Poland, South Korea and the United States. 

DO & CO delivers exceptional culinary experiences, from fine-dining to international events such as UEFA Champions League Finals, FIFA World Cups and Formula 1. We combine culinary excellence and outstanding service to create unforgettable experiences worldwide.

We are searching as per immediate effect for 1 International Sous Chef - Italian Cuisine (m/f/x) Location: Wien ,AT

Department: Kitchen

Contract Type: Full-time

YOUR ROLE IN THE WORLD OF DO & CO 

As International Sous Chef - Italian Cuisine (m/f/x) you will work closely with our Italian team to shape and develop Italian cuisine across the DO & CO Group.

Your main responsibilities:

 * Working at Formula 1 Grand Prix weekends in the Paddock Club®

 * Ensuring the highest quality and service standards

 * Leading and coordinating international kitchen teams

 * Development of menus and food concepts

Qualifications

 * 6+ years of professional experience in luxury gastronomy with a focus on Italian cuisine

 * Completed culinary training

 * Flexibility and willingness to travel to F1 races internationally

 * Efficient and flexible working style

 * Performance-driven mindset and strong team spirit

 * Valid work permit for Austria

 * Excellent English skills (written and spoken); other languages are an advantage

Additional Information

YOUR WORKING ENVIRONMENT

 * An exciting mix of international events and traditional restaurant operations

 * The opportunity to be part of the exclusive world of Formula 1

 * Close collaboration with Executive Chefs around the world

 * Individual long-term career opportunities within the DO & CO Group

 * Attractive above-market compensation, including travel expenses and allowances

 * Daily complimentary freshly prepared lunch and fruit

OUR ATTRACTIVE OFFER

A gross monthly salary of €5,500 per month on a full-time basis (All-In contract). Willingness to overpay depends on qualifications and individual agreement. Additional compensation for F1 event assignments.

Must be willing to relocate to Vienna. A valid work permit for Austria is required. 

We look forward to receiving your application!
